6efd8f7b-7491-4646-b4cc-05589bca92ab.name: I'm blue, if I were green....

e29aa544-f1a4-4ffe-a8d4-7cdd9e4a6cbf.text: I'm blue, if I were green I would die
e29aa544-f1a4-4ffe-a8d4-7cdd9e4a6cbf.name: Blue

8f2d3768-9174-4e0e-89f0-35de3079e804.text: I'm blue, if I were pink I would PIE

c246e26f-2736-4930-8a15-7e0155ca8573.name: Welcome!
c246e26f-2736-4930-8a15-7e0155ca8573.text: Hello, traveler! Welcome to the best planet of the best solar system in the ENTIRE galaxy!

55cd604a-448b-4eb4-bd13-aa8c0f8143c9.name: Intro
55cd604a-448b-4eb4-bd13-aa8c0f8143c9.text: As the OGs of the system, you probably won't want to leave {{neo-var:42b42e00-9b9c-4456-8100-38a8f3cd03f1}} during your stay, but you're mostly welcome to leave whenever you want!

d8f50e6c-86a2-4b77-8309-7304355ce6bc.name: Buy souvenir?
d8f50e6c-86a2-4b77-8309-7304355ce6bc.text: I knew it! Before you continue, would you like to purchase this very special {{neo-var:1e6fc91e-ad08-446e-afff-812af0476e0d}}? It is truly the PINNACLE of human craftsmanship!

d4a4adee-a368-44d7-9d5c-b8483a8ed53a.name: Thank you!
d4a4adee-a368-44d7-9d5c-b8483a8ed53a.text: Fabulous! Hey, I'd recommend staying away from the {{neo-var:49aba70d-30fc-4ae9-8b1c-c5fff5f14e4e}}s. Rumor has it they are causing an uptick in solar flares, but don't worry! That's what the hat is for!

4246b2de-dfd3-4de5-b2c0-f340026a8625.name: Not fashionable
4246b2de-dfd3-4de5-b2c0-f340026a8625.text: That makes sense, not everyone can pull off such fashion.

37137d01-a012-423b-9760-ef9bc8b9f1c2.name: Shock
37137d01-a012-423b-9760-ef9bc8b9f1c2.text: What, here? You might as well turn around right now!

options.text: So you haven't noticed anything strange?
options.name: Question

85859d34-8444-410d-8c77-fed6401527c5.name: Strange cult
85859d34-8444-410d-8c77-fed6401527c5.text: Strange? Hmm...the {{neo-var:8c6427b4-9e59-4f38-8670-2090f21c4117}}s are a strange bunch, constantly staring into the sun. Even with all the solar flares we've been having lately! Blind as a bat, yep.

7a457b41-7a06-43d2-a3e4-c6d2f1bbf41b.name: Jerk
7a457b41-7a06-43d2-a3e4-c6d2f1bbf41b.text: Wow. You're a real jerk, you know that?

d04d75d7-6e7b-44c9-bcc9-7c61a8cb2fd5.name: Blame the mercurials
d04d75d7-6e7b-44c9-bcc9-7c61a8cb2fd5.text: All I know is that there have been an increase in solar flares. Rumor has it the {{neo-var:d922e051-7714-43df-814f-92f977494e03}}s know more. Now get out of here.

b5be7c15-28f8-4dda-a400-d48dfee783cb.name: Optional Mercurial lore
b5be7c15-28f8-4dda-a400-d48dfee783cb.text: Strange bunch, those ones. They are a cult who moved to {{neo-var:23aec2a1-e952-4c13-86fb-e0cede15f33c}} — the planet closest to the sun — so they could stare at it all the time. Super blind, yep.

4620eef5-e9d4-4b2e-93cf-b1f039dbd79b.name: Enjoy your visit!
4620eef5-e9d4-4b2e-93cf-b1f039dbd79b.text: Of course, enjoy your visit to {{neo-var:e9fe0a2b-e192-4a75-b352-e26527e6b423}}!

46e5522e-fe64-49f3-b67e-fb0b1b2ba9d0.name: Impossible to reach
46e5522e-fe64-49f3-b67e-fb0b1b2ba9d0.text: How are you so poor?! You managed to lose the game in a way that should never happen, congratulations!

87a0a8b0-2cdd-4c73-b0a7-1cef41005eb8.name: Guilt trip mercurial warning
87a0a8b0-2cdd-4c73-b0a7-1cef41005eb8.text: Well, hope you brought another hat then. The sun has been flaring up lately. Something to do with the {{neo-var:895da7f1-82ed-4eab-842d-f5dd4c25399a}}s.

0fd9e64b-e419-4adf-ac59-f3bc54ad11a0.name: Optional Mercurial lore
0fd9e64b-e419-4adf-ac59-f3bc54ad11a0.text: Strange bunch, those ones. They are a cult who moved to {{neo-var:3a36f845-8745-458a-8b19-3c9fbd2afee9}} — the planet closest to the sun — so they could stare at it all the time. Super blind, yep.

2e4e76db-6945-4110-ab51-e15ae15b8ec2.name: Hello
2e4e76db-6945-4110-ab51-e15ae15b8ec2.text: Light graces you, brave traveler. We've been expecting you.

options.text: I bet you say that to everyone
options.name: Doubt

9cf20311-811b-4418-8833-00e98e498f55.name: Sun shineth
9cf20311-811b-4418-8833-00e98e498f55.text: Sun shineth for those that seeketh.

options.text: Well, I indeed was sent here to seeketh knowledge.
options.name: Seeketh

options.text: Does the sun shineth for those that seeketh to be blind?
options.name: Mock

8493e593-ab92-41ba-a04d-da2835244bb2.name: Sun offers light
8493e593-ab92-41ba-a04d-da2835244bb2.text: The Sun offereth its Light freely, but it cannot reach those inclined to Darkness.

options.text: Fair enough. Well, I am looking for some information.
options.name: Fair

options.text: Aren't you blind? Sounds pretty dark to me...
options.name: Rude

38b616a1-d31e-4ae4-868c-9bc7bca30cb6.name: Asketh
38b616a1-d31e-4ae4-868c-9bc7bca30cb6.text: Light Shines its abundance on {{neo-var:3d9bdd31-0547-4497-9386-8948d560d35f}}. Ask that which hath evadeth you in Darker realms.

options.text: There are reports of cosmic disturbances
options.name: Cosmic

options.text: I know you have been causing the solar flares (Lie)
options.name: Accuse

b3ece249-34d0-446b-a16a-9c09e6500f39.name: Light to dark
b3ece249-34d0-446b-a16a-9c09e6500f39.text: Ah, so the Light has chosen Darkness as its vessel. Alas, all Light goes Dark in time.

766e702b-009e-4b28-9f5b-b2cb3fe00ec9.name: Cosmos crieth
766e702b-009e-4b28-9f5b-b2cb3fe00ec9.text: Aye, Cosmos crieth out through the Light. It was not Time for Red Nova, yet Time disturbeth all until Nova come.
